complexity.notes: Uses the division operation, contrary to the follow-up constraint; a prefix/suffix product approach would avoid it. The zero-case branch creates O(n) slice copies that could be avoided by iterating over the original list with index checks, and `nums.count(0)` plus `nums.index(0)` make extra passes that could be fused into one. Division is exact here (floor division of an even multiple is exact), so the guaranteed 32-bit/product constraints keep it correct.
complexity.summary: Branches on the number of zeros: with more than one zero every output is 0; with exactly one zero it computes the product of the nonzero elements via two loops over slices; otherwise it computes the total product and divides by each element.
